_about: The dashboard To-Do feed: a short, layman-readable daily checklist of curation work (for Sam) and engineering/pre-curation work (for Fable, the Claude session), rendered by cpl_todos.js as the 📋 To-Do button on every tab. Refreshed at every Rule-8 checkpoint alongside the session handoff (this file is the handoff distilled for the dashboard). Check-off state lives in each viewer's browser (localStorage) and resets when _as_of changes. Keep it SHORT — ≤ ~12 items; done items are deleted, not checked.

NEWEST — the Implementation Funding tab is now a scenario tool ready for the Chancellor: pick the two funding years from dropdowns, flip a Year 1 / Year 2 filter to see that year's priority metrics (your six new metrics are in; every text field is editable), and a new $1M noncredit-feeder carve-out supports NOCE / SD Continuing Ed / Mt. SAC Noncredit / Calbright by headcount (they're out of the college table now — they can't earn CPL metrics). Anyone can play: edits without the team phrase stay in that browser only; unlock with the phrase and your edits become the shared model everyone opens to. STILL THE BIG ONE: the CCR Mind-meld voice pass — the doctrine only becomes YOUR rules when you talk to it.

items.text: NEW MODEL: open Implementation Funding — pick the two years, flip Year 1/Year 2 to see each year's metrics (all editable), check the feeder table at the bottom, and try editing a share or the $1M carve-out. Without the phrase it's your private sandbox; 🔓 Unlock team editing to save the base model for everyone (anything you were exploring is carried over when you unlock).

HEADCOUNTS: 41 of 115 colleges still carry the 2022-23 figure (the tab footnote lists the count). Send the remaining Annual 2025-26 counts when you have them and Fable will drop them in — the mixed-vintage note disappears on its own once complete.

QUICK CALL: the Admin cost still shows $1.2M ('2 FTE × 3 YRS') from the 3-year model — with a 2-year window you may want $800K. It's editable right on the card (unlock first if it should stick for everyone).

MIND MELD (the big one, ~45 min when you can): open ✨ Suggested merges and work a handful of groups with the 🧠 Mind-meld panel — hit 🎤 Dictate and think aloud (why merge, why keep, where the ESL-style packaging line sits). Skim kb/doctrine_out/2026-07-03/calibration_review.md (78 pre-decided calls) and disagree out loud — disagreements are the gold. The KIN/Dance/Music 'one row per activity?' question (Q-TARGETCOUNT) is the single highest-leverage answer.

AFTER Sam's voice pass: distill merge_doctrine_notes → Doctrine v1, re-measure agreement on a fresh sample (gate ≥90%), then batch pass 2 (doctrine-v1@bot, all six lanes, dry-run→skim→apply) + the ESL packaging pilot. Full queue: docs/ccr_convergence_handoff.md.

NEW LOOK: open the Activities tab (sidebar now says just 'Activities', inside the Workplan group). The slim bar sits at the top; 📊 Custom Report now holds BOTH reports — pick ⚡ narrative or 📋 Master, set the audience and the new Elevation slider (sea level = full detail, 30,000 ft = board brief), and watch the progress bar instead of 'Generating…'. Tell Fable if any band's length/detail feels off.

MERGE WHEN READY: a draft PR on cpl-knowledge-base fixes the wrong MAP expansion ('Map Academic Pathways') in the assistant instructions and adds the naming conventions (CPL Initiative / Mapping Articulated Pathways platform / old name history-only). Curation-gated — your review is the audit.

LIVE NOW (your 'Go phase 1'): the team phrase unlocks editing on the Annual Workplan tab (values, titles, + Add row), the Budget dollar cells, the Activity↔Project ✎ links, and TMC curator notes — same phrase as RACI, one unlock covers all tabs. Approve/Return on TMC submissions still needs the magic link on purpose (it's a CO authority claim). Phase 2 (course-curation tabs with a name stamp) is specced — say 'go Phase 2' when you want it.

FACT SHEET NAMING: the public fact sheet still says 'MAP Initiative' in its footer/contact/resources boxes. Safest fix is YOU editing those via ✎ Curate (a code edit could orphan existing Curate overrides — the keys derive from the text). Or tell Fable to do the key-migration version.

HEADLINE NEXT BUILD (decided, carried over): native team-only attachments — private Supabase Storage bucket + project_attachments table + per-card ⬆ Attach; spec in session_97_handoff.md. SharePoint 📎 stays until it lands.
TOP DATA ASK (mid-July): fresh COCI course extract, ideally WITH contact-hours columns; and can the CO export the 200+ pending ADT submissions as a simple list (college, TMC, date)?

Intro Fable to Malone when ready: the Sierra guardrails lane (durable usage limits, daily cost cap, spam protection) needs his thresholds — the cost cap should land BEFORE the endpoint gets publicized.
